landing.tagline: Talk your way through a Chinese city with a companion by your side. Every conversation is practice; every practice grows your DNA.
landing.featWorldDesc: Roam the streets, restaurants and train stations of a living city. Talk to NPCs and survive real situations.
landing.featVoiceDesc: Speak out loud. Your companion reacts to your tones, words and pace — no typing required.
landing.featDnaDesc: Nine live skills build a profile of how you learn, with daily missions that target your weak spots.
landing.featCasesDesc: Solve detective cases in Chinese: listen to witnesses, spot the contradiction, name the culprit.
landing.featDuelsDesc: Battle friends or the Buddy AI on rapid-fire word challenges.
landing.featCompanionsDesc: From Zen capybaras to fierce dragons — each one teaches with a different style and voice.
landing.hskDisclaimer: No affiliation with the official HSK exam — ChineseVerse only estimates your preparation readiness.
